name: Daiba
tagline: Tokyo in 26 minutes and Toranomon in 26 minutes. Served by 1 line.
summary: The station is in Shinagawa City, served by Yurikamome. Journey times to the main business districts are 33 minutes to Otemachi, 41 minutes to Shinjuku, 39 minutes to Shibuya and 30 minutes to Shinagawa. The station stands 5.8 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 5.0 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 5.8 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 3.7 m to 8.7 m, a difference of 5.0 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, neither the station nor any of the nine points within 400 m of it falls inside the projected inundation area. For storm surge, 1 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is among the smallest in the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is フジテレビ湾岸スタジオビル診療所, about 14 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 癌研有明病院, about 38 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
congestion: Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 汐留→竹芝, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Daiba. It is served by the same lines as Daiba. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

neighbours.lead: Tokyo-Teleport is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Daiba is ahead on quiet.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Daiba. Tokyo-Teleport has the Rinkai Line, a different set from Daiba. To Shibuya, for instance, Tokyo-Teleport is 11 minutes quicker. Rents, flood projections and the rest differ little.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want to finish their shopping on foot
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: The 首都高速湾岸線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
台場青海線 (3 lanes each way) runs right beside the station. Traffic on it never stops, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 2 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 6 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Neither the station nor the ground around it falls inside the projected flood area.
leads.stationNote: Only the Yurikamome serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are very lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
